parameters.content:
## IntraWeb — Retell Post-Call Processing

Triggered by Retell AI webhook after every outbound call ends.

**Flow:**
1. Receive Retell webhook
2. Parse outcome + transcript
3. Update HubSpot contact
4. Route by outcome:
   - booked → create deal + confirmation alert
   - not_interested → log + cold nurture
   - callback → log + schedule reminder
   - disqualified → log reason
5. Fire Google Chat alert for all outcomes

**⚠️ Before activating:**
1. Set this webhook URL in Retell agent settings:
   https://n8n.intrawebtech.com/webhook/retell-call-complete
2. Connect HubSpot App Token credential
3. Connect Gmail OAuth credential  
4. Replace YOUR_SPACE_ID in all Google Chat nodes
5. Confirm HubSpot custom properties exist:
   - call_outcome
   - call_summary
   - call_recording_url
   - last_call_timestamp
   - disqualification_reason
   - callback_requested_time
